explication: Disc Image Studio turns source artwork and optional files into physically constrained CD, DVD, or single-layer Blu-ray images, previews the projected/read-back result, and exports or burns it. The graph follows the documented GUI workflow and preserves the separate media-generation, calibration, and burning stages. Edges are limited to relationships shown by README statements or source-index references; some subsystem internals are unsampled, so those connections are omitted.
